acceptance: The Theseus gate job succeeds on exit 3 (status posted, waiting) and fails on exit 2 or any other error. The App-posted status is unchanged, so waiting still shows as failure on the required context and nothing can merge while waiting.
Cancelled-run noise is reduced without weakening concurrency guarantees, or left as is with the reason recorded (see oracle-gate-bridge-noop-runs-hold-runner-slots-20261101).
Docs state that consumers must require the App-posted status context, never the `gate / gate` check-run.
Released and re-locked in BenchBox. On a new PR, `gate / gate` is green while the review is pending, and a forced gate error still turns it red.
context:
Triage 2026-11-07 (read-only, with run ids; the full report is in the session).
- Partly valid.
- `gate / gate` fails on 92% of pull_request_target runs: 267 of 290 since 11-01. 102 PRs were affected, and 72 of 96 merged PRs ended red. Re-locks didn't change this.
- The failure is NOT "cannot resolve a pull request number". That text appears only in the echoed script of the "Resolve the pull request" step, which never failed. That path is unreachable: gate.yml:138-141 skips push, schedule and workflow_run.
- The real cause: gate.py:385-389 exits 3 ("posted, waiting") for every non-pass verdict, and Theseus gate.yml:236 doesn't accept exit 3. The sweep job does accept it (gate.yml:357), and docs/hosted-workflows.md:90 defines 3 as waiting.
- The #4007 BLOCKED claim is false. The cause was an unresolved review thread (required_review_thread_resolution); the PR went CLEAN about 1 minute after the thread was resolved. No ruleset or BenchBox tool reads the `gate / gate` check-run.
- Severity: noise. It hides the rare real gate error: 3 of 381 failures were exit 2, e.g. 41640051806 (HTTP 500).
- Fix in Theseus gate.yml:222-236: treat exit 3 as success/neutral for the job, and keep exit 2 as failure. Then re-lock BenchBox.
- Acceptance criteria 1 and 3 rest on false premises. Dispatch refresh runs attach their check to the develop SHA, so "a later success supersedes" can't apply.
- Little overlap with oracle-gate-bridge-noop-runs-hold-runner-slots-20261101, but its concurrency guardrails apply to any job-level change.
- Recommended priority: low. Fold the fix into Theseus v0.2.4.
description:
`gate / gate` fails on 92% of pull_request_target runs: 267 of 290 since 2026-11-01. 102 PRs were affected, and 72 of 96 merged PRs merged with it red.
Cause:
- Theseus gate.py:385-389 exits 3 ("posted, waiting") for every non-pass verdict.
- The reusable gate.yml gate job (around line 236) treats any non-zero exit as failure, although the sweep job accepts 3 (gate.yml:357) and docs/hosted-workflows.md:90 defines 3 as waiting.
- Green refreshes run as workflow_dispatch and land on the develop SHA, so the PR head's check stays red.
Effects:
- It blocks nothing; the required context is the App-posted `oracle-gate`/`review-gate` status.
- It hides the rare real gate error: exit 2, 3 of 381 failures, e.g. run 41640051806 (HTTP 500).
- Cancel-in-progress also leaves cancelled PR-head gate jobs (59 since 11-01, e.g. #3995).
The original premises were wrong: "cannot resolve a pull request number" is only echoed script text, and #4007 was blocked by an unresolved review thread, not this check.
